action.details: Invokes Scrivener's published “Scrivener/Scrivener: Make New Clipping” macOS Service with the selection.
action.exampleInput: A quotation to capture for the manuscript.
action.exampleOutput: Scrivener creates a new clipping in the current project.

integration.name: Scrivener
integration.summary: Create clippings or append selected text to a Scrivener project.

action.name: Scrivener — New Clipping
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text locally to Scrivener through its macOS Service. Scrivener controls any later sync.
action.requirements: Scrivener 2 or 3 must be installed, a project must be open, and its Make New Clipping Service must be enabled.
action.summary: Create a new clipping in the open Scrivener project.
